summary: Iteration 2 smoke pass. All new backend endpoints (food-festivals, visits/checkin, passport, reviews POST/GET) work. Regression endpoints (anime, locations, auth/login) work. Frontend new pages (/food, /passport) and navbar 6-link layout render correctly. Food page generated 8+ real items from Claude Sonnet 4.5. Passport shows Level 1 / 100 XP / 1 stamp / 5 badges (First Step unlocked) for the test user, and check-in buttons are present and clickable.
passed: POST /api/visits/checkin (suga-shrine) -> 200 {ok:true, already:true} (idempotent; XP already granted in prior iteration)
GET /api/passport -> 200 with keys stamps,total_xp,level,count,badges; level=1 xp=100 count=1 badges=5
POST /api/food-festivals (your-name, demon-slayer, both) -> 200 in ~20s; 8 items with anime,kind,name,location,description,best_time
Frontend navbar shows 6 links: Explore, Atlas, Planner, Companion, Taste, Passport (with Japanese subtitles)
/food: data-testid food-anime-your-name and food-generate-btn present; clicking generate renders 9 food & festival cards
/passport: shows Level 1, XP 100, Stamps 1, 5 badges grid (First Step unlocked, others locked with required stamp counts), Check-in list with CHECK IN buttons
Light sky-blue theme, poster/sticker aesthetic confirmed across landing, food, passport pages

failed.issue: page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle') timed out at 10s on / (root landing). Page visually renders (navbar + hero verified via other pages loaded from same origin). Likely due to continuous marquee animation / long-poll keeping network busy. Non-blocking.
failed.evidence: FAIL landing: Timeout 10000ms exceeded (networkidle). All subsequent pages loaded successfully and navbar visible.
